11 years of Tech Workforce Development

Established in 2014, TKH has been providing high-tech training to thousands of students from underserved communities across the country. With roots in the South Bronx, TKH is a national organization delivering programs in New York, Newark, Atlanta, Los Angeles, and Washington DC.

Our mission is to empower and sustain a talent pipeline of technologists and digital leaders who will uplift their communities.
